problem:
A series RC circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $16\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)\,\text{V},$ a resistance of $80\,Ω,$ and a capacitance of $0.00125\,\text{F}.$ Find the differential equation governing the amount of charge $q$ (in coulombs) on the capacitor at time $t$ (in seconds).

*Hint: The voltage drop ${V}_{C}$ across the capacitor is related to its charge by $q=C{V}_{C},$ where $C$ is the capacitance measured in Farads.*

activity_context.topic_title: Modeling RC Circuits With First-Order ODEs
